scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/retro-relay test && bun run --cwd packages/retro-collector test && bun run --cwd packages/cli test
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:bdd:acceptance
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/retro-relay typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/retro-collector typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/cli typecheck
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/retro-relay build && bun run --cwd packages/retro-collector build && bun run --cwd packages/cli build
scripts.lint: eslint . && bun run lint:gherkin && bun run --cwd packages/cli typecheck
scripts.lint:sh: if command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1; then shellcheck **/*.sh .safeword/hooks/* packages/cli/templates/hooks/* packages/cli/templates/scripts/* 2>/dev/null || true; else echo 'shellcheck not installed; skipping'; fi
scripts.format:sh: shfmt -w -i 2 -ci **/*.sh .safeword/hooks/* packages/cli/templates/hooks/* packages/cli/templates/scripts/* 2>/dev/null || echo 'shfmt not installed (brew install shfmt)'
scripts.deps:graph: depcruise packages/*/src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type dot | dot -T svg > dependency-graph.svg
scripts.test:bdd: bun run test:bdd:acceptance && bun run test:bdd:proof
scripts.test:bdd:acceptance: bun run --cwd packages/cli build && bun run --cwd packages/retro-relay build && NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' cucumber-js --tags 'not @wip and not @proof.vitest and not @manual and not @live'
